> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-1 blocker is fixed. The implementation now separates credential fallback eligibility from cross-repository deduplication: same-repository routes with distinct tokens can still retry credentials, but cannot enter the superseded-copy close path. The new stateful regression phase covers exactly that supported configuration and verifies that the live firing issue remains open and that no close or comment is issued. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
